title: Northgate Optical Lens Option Cancellation Refunds
content:
**Northgate Optical lens option cancellation refund.** In an in-lab cancellation, each light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge of the job is refunded on its own, as one refund credit against that option charge returned to the original tender.

Each option charge receives its own option cancellation refund; the part of an option charge that is not refunded stays billed.

## Booking the refund: `refund_lens_option_d067b0d2`

**Capability.** The tool refunds a lens option charge of an eyewear job as a cancellation refund. One call books one cancellation refund credit against the named option charge, with the amount given, dated today, returned to the member's original tender; the rest of the option charge stays billed. The credit does not earn or take back Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the eyewear job that carries the option charge | identifier, read from the eyewear job lookup |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member who owns the eyewear job | identifier, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the option charge being refunded | identifier, read from the job's charge and credit lookup |
| `option_component` | the component shown on the option charge being refunded, copied from that charge | one of the values below |
| `option_refund_usd` | the amount of the option charge refunded, in USD | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

Values of `option_component` passed to this refund:

- `anti_reflective_coating` — an anti-reflective coating option;
- `photochromic` — the light-adaptive option;
- `blue_light_filter` — the blue-light filtering option.

The component list of the job's charges also contains `frame` (the frame charge, not a lens option), `base_lenses` (the base-lens charge, not an option), `material_upgrade` (the lens material upgrade charge, not an option), `remake_charge` (a remake charge, not an option), `vision_plan_allowance` (a plan allowance entry, not an option) and `frame_allowance` (a plan frame allowance entry, not an option); none of these six is ever passed to this refund.

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_txn_id` (the reference number of the option refund credit), `optical_order_id` (the job), `source_txn_id` (the option charge refunded), `charge_component` (the option refunded), `amount` (the refund, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_reason` (always `cancellation_refund`) and `status` (`posted` when the refund is on the ledger).
